facts.text: Under the Cuyahoga Connect Scholarship, qualifying commuter students from Cuyahoga County pay $15,000 per year, locked for all four years.

sources.title: Financial Aid | Lake Erie College
sources.quote: The Cuyahoga Connect Scholarship supports qualifying students from Cuyahoga County in the Class of 2026. Cost is $7,500 per semester or $15,000 per year Rate locked for four years Designed for full-time commuter students, applied directly to tuition and fees

facts.text: Lake Erie College offers a specialty Twin Scholarship that provides half tuition for each twin enrolled.

sources.title: Financial Aid | Lake Erie College
sources.quote: Twin Scholarship – Half tuition for each twin
